function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours. | Texas Transportation Code §545.1 | | **Seat‑Belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.2 | | **DUI / Driving Under Influence** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§545.3–545.5 | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.6 | | **Headlights & Signal Use** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and when visibility is reduced.
• Turn signals must be used at least 100 ft before turning. | Texas Transportation Code §545.7 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Stop signs, yield signs, and traffic lights dictate priority.
• Pedestrians have the right of way at crosswalks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.8 | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Do not drive in the left lane on a two‑lane road unless passing. | Texas Transportation Code §545.9 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Must remain stopped until the bus resumes motion. | Texas Transportation Code §545.10 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking in handicap spaces unless you have a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.11 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and inspected annually.
• Failure to register can result in fines and impoundment. | Texas Transportation Code §545.12 | | **Driving Licenses** | • Must carry a valid Texas driver’s license.
• International licenses are accepted only for a limited period. | Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) | --- ### How to Stay Updated | Resource | What It Offers | |----------|----------------| | **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** | Official statutes, rule changes, and public notices. | | **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** | Driver licensing, vehicle registration, and enforcement updates. | | **Texas Transportation Code** | The full legal text governing all traffic laws. | | **Local County Courts** | For specific case law and recent rulings. | | **Legal Aid Organizations** | Free or low‑cost legal advice if you’re facing traffic‑related charges. | --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music. 3. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a simple but effective life‑saving measure. 4. **Check your mirrors and blind spots** before changing lanes or turning. 5. **Stay alert for pedestrians and bicyclists**, especially in urban areas. --- #### Need More Specific Information? If you’re looking for details on a particular type of traffic violation, local ordinances, or how a recent court decision might affect you, let me know! I can help locate the relevant statutes or point you toward the right department or legal resource.
